UnlimitedPipe feeds

Free feeds of public records and news: SEC filings and insider trades, sanctions, rate decisions, economic data and market closes, new rules and court rulings, EU laws, drug approvals, critical vulnerabilities, disasters and solar storms, disease outbreaks, crypto, business and tech, science, and news from every region. Every item links to its source.

88 feeds, refreshed by a GitHub Actions workflow scheduled every 1h, and its express lane (activist-stakes, business-news, cloud-status, critical-vulnerabilities, crypto-hacks, disaster-alerts, earthquakes, exploited-vulnerabilities, hurricanes, insider-trades, rate-decisions, sec-company-events, sec-cyber-incidents, security-news, space-weather, thailand-earthquakes, tsunami-alerts, typhoons, us-indicators, world-headlines) every 15m (GitHub starts scheduled runs when it has room, so often less often). Subscribe to any feed in a feed reader (XML), or read it as data (JSON). From a terminal: pip install unlimitedpipe, then unlimited search WORDS or unlimited ask "QUESTION".
